stories.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
stories.brief: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.

stories.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
stories.brief: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

stories.title: 10 killed, 44 injured as passenger bus overturns on highway in Punjab's Rajanpur
stories.brief: DERA GHAZI KHAN: Ten people were killed and 44 others injured when a passenger bus overturned after hitting a road divider on the Indus Highway in Rajanpur district’s Rojhan tehsil, Rescue 1122 said.

stories.title: Government websites go dark after AI-discovered flaw sparks security scramble
stories.brief: Government websites in Europe and elsewhere went offline on Wednesday after the disclosure of critical vulnerabilities in a widely used programming language sent website operators around the world scrambling to protect their systems.

stories.title: 17 sugar mill workers remain missing after abduction in K-P's DI Khan
stories.brief: At least 17 sugar mill workers remained missing after unidentified armed men abducted passengers and workers from a passenger coach and a sugar mill bus near Cheera Minor on the Indus Highway in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's Dera Ismail Khan, while several passengers have been released.

stories.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to Pakistan and 25 more countries in bid to boost revenue
stories.brief: OpenAI said on Wednesday it was expanding advertising on ChatGPT to Pakistan and 25 additional countries, bringing the total number of markets where ads are available to 89, as the artificial intelligence company seeks to grow revenue ahead of a potential initial public offering.

stories.title: PTI dismisses reports of internal rifts as Dogar signals possible resumption of talks with government
stories.brief: He expressed full confidence in opposition leaders Mahmood Khan Achakzai and Allama Raja Nasir Abbas, saying they had been entrusted with responsibilities by the party’s founding chairman and that party members were expected to support them.

stories.title: ECP orders fresh schedule for Islamabad local government polls
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) on Wednesday directed its office to prepare and issue the election programme for local government elections in the Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT).

stories.title: 10 killed, 35 injured as bus overturns on Rajanpur's Indus Highway
stories.brief: At least 10 passengers were killed and 35 injured on Wednesday when a passenger bus travelling from Karachi to Dera Ghazi Khan overturned after hitting a divider on an under-construction road near Bangla Hidayat on the Indus Highway in Rajanpur, Rescue 1122 said.

stories.title: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
stories.brief: The fine is the largest to date against Facebook's owner, larger than an $18bn deal with California.

stories.title: Fuel leak which killed fish in River Taff stopped
stories.brief: GE Aerospace previously confirmed fuel got into the river while repair work took place nearby.

stories.title: Burnham proposes plan to cut standing charges from gas bills
stories.brief: The prime minister provided little detail, and there are questions over shifting the fees onto unit costs.

stories.title: How much gas could Jackdaw provide? And will it cut your energy bills?
stories.brief: BBC Verify looks at what the Jackdaw decision means for bills, energy security and the environment.

stories.title: Inflation and government borrowing highest for a year ahead of next week's Budget
stories.brief: Inflation accelerated to 3.5% from 3.1% in the year to September, according to the Office for National Statistics (ONS).

stories.title: What is happening to UK prices?
stories.brief: UK inflation rose in September, pushed up by higher petrol and diesel prices.

stories.title: The tech helping crack decades-old cold cases
stories.brief: Investigative genetic genealogy can help hunt down criminals but raises worries over privacy.

stories.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wins dismissal of sister's lawsuit
stories.brief: A US district judge dismissed the case after Ann Altman had refused to attend an independent medical examination.

stories.title: Trump sued over Canadian tariffs in latest legal challenge
stories.brief: The lawsuit argues the White House exceeded its authority in imposing the latest tariffs on the country and caused "immediate harm to American businesses".

stories.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
stories.brief: Revolut was one of the hardest hit, with banking services going down for many customers.

stories.title: US judge dismisses sexual abuse lawsuit from Sam Altman’s sister
stories.brief: Ann Altman, the Open AI CEO’s sister, accused her brother of repeatedly sexually abusing her over two decades agoA judge dismissed a lawsuit filed by Sam Altman’s sister against him on Tuesday.
